summary: Frontend-only regression for the reader/cover redesign + Home tile cleanup. All 6 requested acceptance areas pass: Home tiles no longer expose count/hint testIDs and category selection toggles work; the reader shows a dedicated cover page with a single meta pill (reader-meta / reader-category-icon / reader-kind-label / reader-duration-label) and the full cover title; reader-header-title has computed opacity 0 at scroll top and animates to 1 once the cover title scrolls past; the intro block is below the fold at load (top y=784, vh=844) and its 'Leggi/Read' CTA (label='Read' in EN) becomes visible after scrolling; the deprecated reader-audio-corner testID is gone from source and DOM; premium user gets an 'Ascolta/Listen' CTA rendered via IntroCtaButton with an identical bounding box to Leggi (166x60 at 390px). Audio sheet opens on tap, closes via audio-sheet-close (removed from DOM), audio-mini-badge appears in the header and re-opens the sheet. No console errors. Chapter snapping/scrolling reaches the ReaderEnding card (Remember This + Continue button) at the bottom. No deprecated Expo packages detected in the touched files.

issues: audio-mini-badge bounding box (x=344,y=60,w=33,h=33) intersects the reader-header-title bounding box (x=36,y=18,w=318,h=48) by ~10px horizontally and ~6px vertically at 390px viewport when the title wraps to 2 lines. Visually the title text is centered and does not touch the badge, but the boxes DO overlap because the title container uses alignSelf:'stretch' spanning full width. Consider reserving right padding on the title (e.g. paddingRight: 44) when a corner is rendered, so bounding boxes never intersect. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/reader-header.tsx (styles.title / styles.corner).

action_items: Optional polish: reserve right padding on reader-header-title (or clamp title max-width) when the AudioMiniBadge corner is rendered, so the two bounding boxes never intersect at 390px when the title wraps to 2 lines. Visual text is fine today; only bbox overlap.
Optional: expose a stable testID on the ReaderEnding container (e.g. testID='reader-ending') to make regression assertions easier. Today we verified visually via screenshot.
critical_code_review_comments: intro-cta-button.tsx correctly uses expo-image with the same ART assets for 'book' and 'headphones' and identical minHeight=58 + shared flex:1 style from the parent (styles.cta), guaranteeing width/height parity of Leggi and Ascolta.

story-meta-chips.tsx (size='md') renders a single unified pill containing category-icon + kind + duration with all requested testIDs (reader-meta, reader-category-icon, reader-kind-label, reader-duration-label). Good.
reader-header.tsx animates opacity via the `reveal` shared value driven from deep-dive/[id].tsx CoverTitle onLayout + scrollY interpolate — verified via runtime opacity checks (0 -> 1).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 6 acceptance groups pass; 1 minor design nit)

To exercise premium flow, curl POST /api/user/premium {user_id, active:true} then reload the reader. audio-mini-badge only appears after tapping deep-dive-listen-ai and closing the audio-sheet. Header title reveals only after scrolling past the big cover title (~coverH). Screenshots for this iteration are in /app/test_reports/*.jpeg.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional bugs. The only observation is a purely geometric bounding-box overlap between the audio-mini-badge (positioned absolute right/bottom inside the header) and the header title's stretched container. Because the title uses alignSelf:'stretch' + textAlign:'center', the flex container spans the full row width even though the glyphs are centered and narrow. Fix idea: add paddingRight (or a right margin equal to badge width + spacing) to styles.title when a corner is present, or wrap the title in a View with maxWidth: winW - 2*(badgeWidth+spacing).
